description_en: Adds check items to the whitelist for cloud platform configuration checks
description_zh: 云平台配置检查把检查项加入白名单
name: AddCheckResultWhiteList

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the check items.
Call the [ListCheckResult](~~ListCheckResult~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
检查项ID集合。
调用[ListCheckResult](~~ListCheckResult~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: check_ids

parameters.help_en:
The rule type. Default value: WHITE. Valid values:
WHITE: adds to the whitelist
parameters.help_zh:
规则类型。默认WHITE。取值：
WHITE: 加白名单
parameters.name: rule_type

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Different requests should use different tokens. The token supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 客户端 Token，用于保证请求幂等性。不同请求应使用不同的 Token；只支持 ASCII 字符，长度不超过 64 个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance IDs of the cloud service instances to add to the whitelist. Separate multiple instance IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 需要加白的云产品实例ID。多个ID使用英文逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: instance_ids
